design: A malicious lesser demon dungeon warrior, crimson/burnt-red skin, angular horned face with TWO swept-back dark horns, narrow golden eyes and a jagged fanged sneer, short black crest. Exactly TWO muscular clawed arms, TWO digitigrade hoofed legs and TWO compact leathery bat wings, one barbed tail. Dark iron wrist guards, leather belt and ragged charcoal waistcloth; no handheld weapon. Painted/cel-shaded medieval fantasy villain matching player art, impish and hostile not cute or realistic gore. Grounded three-quarter facing RIGHT. Idle hooves planted, chest breathing/blink and folded-wing twitch; hurt curls inward and snarls; attack winds claw then slashes/lunges toward RIGHT; dodge hunches low and leans back with wings tucked, recovery. Same anatomy/horns/tail all16poses, ample empty margins around wings/tail.
prompt:
STYLE/ANATOMY REFINEMENT. Reference image ONE is the actual playable swordsman and is the EXACT standard for rendering style and grounded proportions. Reference image TWO is the enemy sprite sheet to REDRAW/REFINE. Preserve this enemy's identity, clothing, colors, equipment and ALL SIXTEEN corresponding actions in the same 4x4 layout.
The enemy currently looks too chibi/cartoonish. Make it MORE SERIOUS and proportionally grounded, matching the PLAYABLE CHARACTER reference. For adult human-like bodies use approximately FOUR to FOUR-AND-A-HALF head units of height, smaller anatomically sized head and eyes, longer natural torso/legs/forearms, credible joints and hands, restrained hostile expressions. No giant baby head, stubby child limbs, huge eyes, silly smirks, exaggerated cartoon acting, cute mascot or toy look. For nonhuman anatomy retain its species characteristics but apply the same mature serious treatment.
Keep the polished HAND-PAINTED 2D fantasy RPG finish, crisp detailed outlines and material shading of image ONE, no photorealism, gore or horror. Same side three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. An ADULT lesser demon, not a childlike imp. Use a smaller angular skull and eyes, strong mature jaw, longer muscular torso, forearms and digitigrade legs, roughly 4 to4.5 head units of standing body height excluding horns. Serious predatory glare, no mischievous cute smile or baby cheeks. Preserve crimson skin, dark swept horns, black crest, wrist guards, ragged waistcloth, TWO arms, TWO hoofed legs, TWO wings and ONE barbed tail. Keep wings/horns clearly complete in all16poses and retain the same attack/dodge actions.
Four equal columns and FOUR rows: idle, hurt, attack, dodge. Four distinct coherent poses per action. Same redesigned mature body proportions and camera scale across all16poses. Idle fixed support/body root with only slight breathing and blink. Hurt clear recoil, attack readable wind-up/strike/recovery, dodge evasion/recovery. Same weapon held visibly in EVERY pose including blink/hurt/dodge. All figures complete, ample transparent spacing between cells and outer margins, no neighbor overlap or clipping. Real transparent background, no text, grid lines, scenery, shadows or detached effects.
